description: Base transaction verification: did it land, did it succeed, how many confirmations, what did it cost. When to use: an agent or merchant must confirm a Base payment before releasing value. Data source: external Base JSON-RPC (no self-hosted Base node). Returns: found, status (success|failed|pending), block, confirmations, from, to, value, gas_used, fee_wei, logs, contract_created. Free: no metering.
name: base_get_transaction
